name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo Velez is a seasoned finance controller with over 25 years of experience, the last 12 of which have been dedicated to the high-octane world of motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Ricardo transitioned from traditional corporate finance after attending a local karting event that reignited his passion for the sport. He believes in a meticulous, data-driven approach, ensuring financial stability and responsible resource allocation for Cool Racing. Ricardo's strength lies in his ability to foresee potential financial pitfalls and opportunities, allowing the team to make informed decisions that contribute to both on-track performance and long-term financial health.

His analytical mindset and proactive approach have made him an invaluable asset to the team, and he is known for his ability to remain calm and collected under pressure, especially during crucial moments in the racing season. Ricardo's commitment to fiscal responsibility and his deep understanding of the intricacies of motorsport finance set him apart, ensuring that Cool Racing remains competitive and sustainable in the long run. He is dedicated to empowering the team's financial success through sound financial strategies and a passion for excellence.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a sturdy build and a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Insists on double-checking all spreadsheets manually, even if the computer results are correct.
Listens to classical music while working to stay focused.
